experiment: L2+ pose-conditioned templates and the causal pool (D2)
query_set: 179 queries whose identity has a same-camera morning gallery entry
frame_height: h = median person-box height of the track, native pixels
kernel: w = exp(-|log(h_gallery/h_query)| / sigma); sigma = 0.6, five-fold by identity, plateau 0.30-0.60
pool_rule: causal: only observations earlier than the query are written; the query itself is excluded
face_quality_gate: usable = pd>=20 and fw>=32 and lap>=50 and |yaw|<=0.35 and 0.25<=pitch<=0.95
note: face_match_tau is the middle value of the swept list [0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45]; the paper's 'similarity gate 0.35' refers to this value, not to the selector tau
